blocks.text: We can group hormones into three main chemical categories.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book says “three main chemical categories” but then describes four: 1. peptide and protein hormones, 2. glycoprotein hormones, 3. amino acid derivatives and 4. steroid hormones. By the book's own sections, hormones are grouped into four main chemical categories.
